outcomes: The extracted SDD surfaces answer byte-for-byte what the built-in CLI implementation answered before it was deleted
The extension binary knows the workspace only through the wire, so the CLI can evolve internals without breaking it
nonGoals: Specifying the SDD engine's own verdicts, which tooling/sdd-extension owns

requirements.text: Every subcommand and tool is pinned byte-for-byte against answers recorded from the CLI implementation it replaced, captured before that implementation was deleted; the recording has no update flag, because the only code that could rewrite it is the code under test.

The extension binary does not import the CLI's internal packages, does not replace into tooling/cli, and does not exec putnami at run time; a workspace fact it needs and the wire does not carry is closed as an additive member of protocols/job or protocols/extension, never re-derived here.
